entries.li: Fixed a bug introduced in the previous update that caused ranger taming outposts to repeatedly throw errors.
Fixed a bug introduced in the previous update that caused component mismatches in research outposts.
Added a distinct map icon for every outpost type.
The version number was incorrect earlier and has now been corrected. If you see this notice twice, that is fine.
Improved research outposts. Also, remember to add extension facilities to your research outposts if you have overlooked them.
Added school outposts and education facilities.
Added cultural indoctrination facilities and a dedicated Indoctrination page.
Greatly improved facility information display. Vanilla and Modern styles now use more consistent information logic.
Improved activation requirements, status tips and descriptions so actual mechanics are clearer.
Improved trade-order events. If an order quest cannot be generated, a follow-up event now occurs instead of the order silently failing.
Improved mechanitor outposts. The core relay now gains 2 additional bandwidth for each outpost level, and expanded band nodes now provide 2 bandwidth.
Added the "Invincible quantum power" setting, which removes distance-based efficiency loss from remote power transmission.
Quality-of-life improvements.
Improved the Vanilla-style interface to more closely match RimWorld's original UI. Hope you like it!
Pawns now release their assigned beds when entering an outpost.
Improved outpost defense calculations.
Fixed errors when DLCs are not enabled.
Fixed a bug that could cause UI clicks to fail intermittently.
Added watchtowers that provide stacking defense bonuses to their own outpost and friendly outposts on adjacent tiles.
Improved the calculation and display of skill requirements for enabling facilities.
Added explanations of defense and outpost attack points, and improved tip formatting and facility and outpost descriptions.
Improved how personnel work speed is calculated.
Improved the color scheme.
Improved the caravan-outpost goods exchange feature.
Added training base outposts, where training facilities train residents faster.
Improved the in-game information and tips.
Improved the interaction experience.
Improved the in-game tips.
Added a night variant of the Modern Tech style.
Added the ability to exchange goods between caravans and outposts.
Improved the Modern Tech style visuals.
Fixed faulty code that caused stuttering.
Added power outposts that provide an extra power generation multiplier.
Greatly reduced outpost upgrade requirements.
Improved the power generation display text.
Fixed compatibility issues.
Improved some descriptions.
Improved the in-game tips and data readouts.
The interval of outpost random events and attacks can now be adjusted, or disabled entirely.
Fixed some mistakes in the English text.
